summary: Iteration 24 (frontend fix retest): Verified /discovery header count decrements immediately on Player request send. Desktop (1920x1080) and Mobile (375x800) both confirmed. Backend regression (iters 19-23, 54 tests) still 100% green.
critical_code_review_comments: Discovery.jsx L199-217: count is computed inline via IIFE inside JSX — fine but a useMemo(() => actionable, [deck, friendSet, sentSet]) would be marginally clearer and avoid recomputation on unrelated re-renders.
sentSet/friendSet are new Set() rebuilt on every render (matchStore inbox reference stability); this is fine at N<=100 but consider useMemo if the deck grows to hundreds.

Positive-control 'reload after send' scenario: the backend now excludes sent-request targets from /api/discovery (iter 23 fix), so on reload the deck is *replenished* to N=24 with new candidates rather than showing N-1. The FE-derived counter is correct given the deck contents; the requirement wording ('N-1 after reload') no longer applies once the BE also filters. Recommend clarifying the product spec — current behaviour is sensible and consistent.
test_credentials: Firebase Identity Toolkit signUp with random TEST_i24_* / TEST_i24m2_* emails.
seed_data_creation: Seed users (24 auto-seeded demo players) already present; no new seeds required. Test users left as Firebase accounts (not cleaned up in this run — same pattern as prior iterations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The FE fix requires skipping the onboarding modal (name+next flow) before navigating to /discovery — the first automation attempt failed the click flow because the modal was blocking. Use `input[placeholder*="Sam Putter"]` + iterate Next/Skip buttons. `data-testid="discovery-count"` and `player-status-sent-<uid>` are the canonical selectors added this iteration.
rca of the issue: Original iter-23 fix only touched the backend exclude set. The frontend Discovery.jsx still rendered `deck.length` as the header count, and deck items are never removed on send (intentional — cards stay visible with a Sent pill). So the counter appeared stuck at 24 until a fresh /api/discovery fetch. This iteration derives the visible count from `deck.filter(p => !friendSet.has(p.uid) && !sentSet.has(p.uid)).length`, and matchStore.sendFriendRequest optimistically adds to sent_friend_request_uids — verified in devtools network log (POST /api/friend-requests/<uid> → 200, count re-renders synchronously).
